description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Vavuniya District
categorisation: This gazette notice pertains to the postponement and rescheduling of elections for Local Authorities in the Vavuniya district. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, notifications for nominations, and the declaration of poll dates. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes, including the calling for nominations, setting poll dates, and postponement due to funding issues, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7).
